tools.name: ver_medios
tools.description: Lists the active publications of the network with name, URL, topics covered, what each accepts and the link to its criteria page. Read only.

tools.name: ver_condiciones
tools.description: Returns the terms: free allowance, package prices, labelling of paid and free releases, what is not published, how the process works. Read only. Call before enviar_nota.

tools.name: enviar_nota
tools.description: For agencies and communications teams: submit a press release, follow its status and get the published URL for the client report. We email a confirmation request to the given sender address; the review starts only after that email is answered. Publication is an editorial decision, not guaranteed. Fr

tools.name: buscar_notas
tools.description: Finds press releases already published by the network for a company or website domain (title, publication, date, URL, how it is labelled), for example to document where a client appeared. Public information only, at most 20 results, newest first. Read only.

tools.name: estado_nota
tools.description: Status of a submission by ticket: waiting for confirmation, in review, published (with URL), rejected, answered by email, waiting for payment, expired. Read only.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ver_medios, enviar_nota, buscar_notas, estado_nota · Private data: buscar_notas · Public sink: enviar_nota, estado_nota.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ver_medios, enviar_nota, buscar_notas, estado_nota · Private data: buscar_notas · Public sink: enviar_nota, estado_nota

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
